content.short: An MEV-powered liquid staking and order-flow coordination layer built for the high-throughput Monad blockchain.
content.description:
aPriori is an MEV-powered liquid staking and order-flow coordination layer designed specifically for the Monad blockchain. It allows users to stake MON tokens and receive aprMON, a liquid token that can be used across DeFi while earning rewards. The protocol captures Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) and redistributes those profits back to stakers and validators to provide significantly higher yields.

Beyond staking, aPriori acts as an intelligent layer that identifies and isolates predatory transactions. This optimizes execution for regular users and ensures a fair and efficient environment within the high-performance Monad network.
